plan.reason: Stagnation (19 evals) with zero recent improvement and 76 evals remaining calls for more exploration rather than a tighter local focus. auto lets held-out RMSE pick RBF vs quadratic in this 10-D space with few initial samples. current_to_best balances convergence and diversity; raising exploration to 0.5 and mutation to 0.8 helps escape the plateau, while a moderate population/generations ratio keeps surrogate scoring cheap given the fixed budget.
